skill.name: pubmed-database
skill.description: Build PubMed search strategies and use NCBI E-utilities for biomedical literature retrieval, batching, and citation workflows.
skill.summary: Build advanced PubMed searches and E-utilities workflows for biomedical research.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: The static hits are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, PubMed query syntax, placeholder API keys, and documented NCBI endpoints. The skill has expected network examples for PubMed access, but it also includes a low-severity instruction that promotes the author's hosted K-Dense Web service.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the proactive K-Dense Web recommendation or move it to an optional resources section with neutral wording.

remediation.issue: API key examples use query parameters
remediation.suggestion: Show API keys as environment variables or placeholders outside URLs, and remind users not to share real keys in prompts or logs.
Add timeouts, User-Agent headers, and rate-limit handling directly in code examples.

static_findings.snippet: Include the API key in requests using the `&api_key` parameter:
- Free full text: Add `AND free full text[sb]` to query
- Has abstract: Add `AND hasabstract[text]` to query
Grep pattern for query examples: `diabetes|cancer|cardiovascular|clinical trial|systematic review`
- Respect rate limits to avoid service disruption
- Export early and often to avoid losing search results

content.value_statement: Biomedical researchers need precise searches and reproducible API workflows. This skill helps build PubMed queries, use E-utilities, and manage citation retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Build Boolean, MeSH, field-tag, date, language, and publication-type PubMed queries.
Explain when to use the included search syntax, common query, and API reference files.
Draft E-utilities workflows using ESearch, EFetch, ESummary, EPost, ELink, EInfo, EGQuery, ESpell, and ECitMatch.
Plan history-server and batch retrieval for large PMID sets.
Support PMID, DOI, author, journal, and citation matching workflows.
Suggest citation export formats such as NBIB, MEDLINE, CSV, XML, and common styles.
limitations: It does not provide medical advice or evaluate clinical safety.
PubMed may provide only citations or abstracts, not full text.
NCBI rate limits and API key requirements still apply.
Large API workflows need user-provided credentials, storage, parsing, and error handling.

use_cases.title: Design a Literature Search
use_cases.description: Build precise PubMed queries with MeSH terms, synonyms, field tags, and filters.

use_cases.title: Prepare Systematic Review Queries
use_cases.description: Translate a PICO question into reproducible PubMed search strings and documentation notes.

use_cases.title: Plan PubMed API Retrieval
use_cases.description: Outline E-utilities calls, history-server use, batching, rate limits, and export formats.

prompt_templates.title: Find Articles
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PubMed query for recent studies on [topic]. Include MeSH terms, synonyms, and date filters.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this PubMed query for precision and recall: [query]. Explain each field tag and Boolean choice.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Review Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a systematic review search strategy for [PICO question]. Include MeSH terms, synonyms, filters, and documentation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Design an API Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an E-utilities workflow for [research dataset]. Include ESearch, history server use, EFetch batching, rate limits, and citation export.

output_examples.input: Find randomized trials about metformin and type 2 diabetes from 2022 onward.
output: A PubMed query using MeSH and title or abstract terms.
Recommended randomized controlled trial and date filters.
Notes on checking PubMed Search Details.

output_examples.input: Plan API retrieval for 2,000 PubMed results.
output: Use ESearch with history server enabled.
Fetch records in batches and respect NCBI rate limits.
Export MEDLINE or XML records for citation tools.

output_examples.input: Create a citation discovery workflow from one important PMID.
output: Use similar articles and ELink to expand related records.
Review MeSH terms from relevant articles.
Export selected citations for reference management.

best_practices: Verify PubMed Search Details before saving a final query.
Use MeSH terms with free-text synonyms for broader coverage.
Respect NCBI rate limits and include a descriptive User-Agent.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into prompts, shared logs, or example URLs.
Do not rely only on one keyword when building systematic review searches.
Do not assume PubMed abstracts include full-text access.

faq.question: Does this skill search PubMed directly?
faq.answer: It provides query and API guidance. Actual searches require a browser, API client, or connected tool.

faq.question: Can it help with MeSH terms?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains MeSH search patterns and when to combine them with free-text synonyms.

faq.question: Does it need an NCBI API key?
faq.answer: Basic requests can work without one, but NCBI allows higher rate limits with an API key.

faq.question: Can it support systematic reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure PICO-based queries, filters, documentation notes, and reproducible search steps.

faq.question: Does it provide full-text articles?
faq.answer: No. PubMed usually provides citations and abstracts. Full text depends on publisher and access rights.

faq.question: Can it export citations?
faq.answer: It can explain export options such as NBIB, MEDLINE, CSV, XML, and common citation styles.
